description: Shared by the AI assistant (apps/pos-ai-companion: Settings/ShopProfile.cs) and the Setup Studio (tools/setup-studio/lib/aiprofile.mjs): how profile/ai.json is read, and what the Studio writes. "read": "input" (a JSON value) or "raw" (text) is the file; "value" is what the program ends up with (models as it names them, "Model 1" when a photo has no title) and "problems" are the things it leaves out, in order, in its own words. "build": "intake" is the part of a customer's details the file is made from, "file" is what the Studio writes, "problems" are things the Studio could not write, and "read" is what the program ends up with when it reads that file (with no problem). Made by tools/setup-studio/scripts/make-ai-profile-vectors.mjs.
